title: Vandals cut cables at Phivolcs station monitoring Kanlaon volcano
summary: Personnel of the Kanlaon Volcano Observatory discovered cables at its Sitio Manghumay, Mailum Observation Station cut when they conducted a routine inspection on November 18.
